 singapore Police seek information on missing 13-year-old girl last seen near Geylang apartments
 Rachel Pun Ziqi, 13, was reported missing at about 11.35pm on Thursday (Oct 22) Those with information on the whereabouts of Rachel are urged to contact the police hotline at 1800-255-0000 or submit information online at www.police.gov.sg/i-witness. PHOTO: Singapore Police Force (left), Google Maps (right) PUBLISHED ON October 23, 2026 1:00 AM UPDATED October 23, 2026 5:56 AM BY AsiaOne The police are appealing for information on the whereabouts of a 13-year-old girl, Rachel Pun Ziqi, who was last seen in Geylang.
 Police said in a news release on Friday (Oct 23) that Rachel was last seen at about 11.35pm on Thursday in the vicinity of Block 8 Lorong 39 Geylang, wearing a light-coloured t-shirt and dark-coloured pants.
 The address is the location for the 112-unit residential development Sims Residences.
 Anyone with information is urged to contact the police hotline at 1800-255-0000 or submit information online at www.police.gov.sg/i-witness .
 All information will be kept strictly confidential.
